rule: top-8 minutes shares from the most recent captured official game book for that team, plus the pro-rata replacement shares that apply when one of those eight is out. The denominator is the team-minutes total printed on the game book's own totals row (240 for a regulation game, 290 for the 11/12 DET@WAS two-overtime game), never an assumed 240.
extraction_notes: 20261114_DALCLE.pdf: the extraction dropped the 'VISITOR: Dallas Mavericks' header; those rows are attributed to DAL from the official file name and flagged.
20261114_BKNMEM.pdf: the extraction merged the Nets' final row with the team-total row; that row is dropped (it fails the box-score identity) and the totals still reconcile.
20261115_INDPHI.pdf: the home block's bench rows are shifted by one empty column and drop PTS; minutes are unaffected and are the only field taken from those rows.
